title: Fifteens
description: A Northern Irish no-bake classic — crushed caramel digestives, condensed milk and marshmallows rolled into a log and sliced. So called because the originals contain fifteen of everything.

ingredients.text: 300g condensed milk (around ¾ of a tin)

steps: Put 15 digestives in a ziplock bag and bash with a rolling pin until crushed into crumbs. Tip into a bowl and add the condensed milk.
Chop the marshmallows into quarters (scissors work better than a knife) and add to the biscuit mix. Stir until combined.
Lay a large rectangle of cling film on a flat surface. Put the remaining digestives in a bag and crush. Scatter them over the central area of the cling film.
Spoon the mixture on to the cling film over the crushed digestives. Fold the cling film over, twist the ends like a cracker, then roll into a fat log around 10cm in diameter.
Put on a plate or baking tray and refrigerate overnight.
When set, slice into 1cm-thick slices to serve.
notes: Makes 10–12 slices. No baking required. Store in an airtight tin once set — no need to keep in fridge.
